title: Chapter 563
text:
Godora paid a lot of attention to this news. Nagojin had already reported on Han Xiao's abilities, so the upper echelons were more concerned about another problem. Han Xiao had released the news that Blue Star was bound to Floating Dragon Island through reporters.

While Floating Dragon was a neutral organization without any political factors, its influence was extraordinary.

With the name of Floating Dragon, even if Blue Star was in the Garton Star System that Godora controlled, they would not be able to manage Blue Star. This planet might become a special area under their jurisdiction.

Furthermore, the value of roping in Floating Dragon was far higher than Blue Star. Blue Star was just a low-level planet, and as long as there was no political conflict, Godora decided to turn a blind eye.

Of course, compared to Dark-star, Blue Star was just a small problem. After the news was released, Godora's official media department also came out to join in the fun and promote it to increase the popularity of the news. No matter who won against Dark-star, as long as they could suppress Dark-star, they were willing to promote it.

…

Floating Dragon Island …

After Jenny finished reading the news, her face turned green, and she immediately contacted Ames.

Ames was currently traveling in the galaxy, and her virtual projection appeared on the communicator.

"What's wrong?"

"Look at the news! Black Star is causing trouble outside again! "Jenny pressed the communicator and sent the news link over.

Ames looked at it for a while and smiled.

"As expected of the person I value. He's quite impressive."

"That's not the main point. He announced that Blue Star is Floating Dragon's sub-base without my permission!" Jenny was furious.

"But I agreed." Ames blinked.

Jenny immediately swallowed the curse words that she was about to say.

"I recently accepted two disciples. They're also from Blue Star. Black Star will bring them to Floating Dragon soon. Help them settle down."

After that, Ames hung up.

"Ah! Black Star!"

The staff outside the door suddenly heard Jenny's angry scream, and they were all shocked.

…

Somewhere in the Shattered Star Ring, in the territory of a certain Beyond Grade A Supers.

"Taking on the main cannon head-on … that's my style. Ames now has a powerful cadre."

In the shadows, a robust giant that was seven to eight meters tall sat on a throne, looking at the news on the virtual screen in front of him with a contemplative expression.

"Floating Dragon is starting to expand, and Ames is finally interested in the forces. Hmm … I'll find some time to propose to her again. I might succeed this time."

…

The Dark-star mothership that attacked Blue Star was drifting in space. Ashes and the other two also saw the news.

"Bullshit, when did he beat us up?!"

Degulish was enraged. "It was clearly Black Star who did not have any ability to retaliate. These bunch of reporters only know how to make things up!"

Terry said helplessly, "In any case, we really couldn't kill him."

Ashes snorted and did not comment. He was secretly thinking about how to get rid of Han Xiao.

"He definitely has a weakness. The matter of planting spies in his mercenary group has to be put on the agenda. Only by getting close to him will we be able to discover his weakness."

"Then, what should we do next?" Terry asked.

Degulish frowned and slowly said.

"Black Star's ability was beyond our expectations, and we were unable to kill him. This mission has failed, and the leader said that this is not our fault. No one knows how many abilities Black Star has hidden. He wants us to gather with the main forces and prepare for the next step of the plan."

"Next step?"

"We don't know the exact details yet, but since we're gathering the motherships, it will definitely be a large-scale operation," Degulish said.

Dark-star was still planning for the next round of attacks.

However, Dark-star did not know that Han Xiao had planted an eye in their spring.

All the motherships were exposed to Risda's surveillance, and Dark-star's backup was already useless. They were still in the dark.

…

As the news spread, many people in the Shattered Star Ring were discussing the name of Black Star. His fame had spread far and wide, and it had brought Han Xiao a lot of fame.

Dark-star had been forced back twice and seemed to have finally calmed down.

However, this was only the calm before the storm. A storm created by Han Xiao was brewing in the dark.

Risda was monitoring the location of Dark-star's motherships. Every once in a while, Han Xiao would reveal the coordinates to the upper echelons of the War Bureau through Nagojin. Godora had the intention of catching them all in one fell swoop and secretly sent out troops.

Godora continued to hire large mercenary groups as protection, but they did not reveal the details of the operation. They only told Sky Ring, Purple Gold, Blades, and the other large mercenary groups to be on standby.

Han Xiao remained in Blue Star and focused on his plan to recruit players. The plan had already reached a critical stage.

Making use of this ambush, Han Xiao changed the name of his faction through the faction interface and the Mercenary Alliance user interface.

The name of [Black Star Mercenary] was changed to …

[Black Star Corps]!

Those that dared to use 'Corps' as the suffix were basically large mercenary groups.

Due to the large number of players joining, Han Xiao's faction had expanded to hundreds of thousands of people. Just in terms of numbers, they had already entered the ranks of this group. No one in the mercenary world would object to this change.

With regards to this decision, Han Xiao gave a speech to all the players, emphasizing that it was because of the players that the faction changed its name, making the players feel that their actions had helped the faction grow.

Changing a name for this reason was easier to cultivate a sense of collective honor and belonging to the players, making them feel that this was a faction that belonged to them.

At the same time, this was also a signal to the players that they were about to leave Blue Star and enter the next stage very soon.

From the players' point of view, changing the name of the faction this time was a transition event that they were about to enter the galaxy!

This kind of behavior that was similar to cultivating corporate culture could only have a better effect when coupled with substantial benefits. Han Xiao released a new product at the right time.

He bought two new Pugilist and Esper class class advancement knowledges through the galactic online trading platform, spending more than 100,000 Enas, and placed them in the faction store. What shocked the players was that these two new knowledges did not charge money like the other knowledges but only required experience!

At the same time, there was no prerequisite to purchase Faction Favorability.

With regards to this matter, Han Xiao explained it to Philip.

The Black Star Corps would provide two class advancement knowledges' for free 'to cultivate and train the new mercenaries under their command.

This move instantly ignited the excitement of the players!

Han Xiao sold his Mechanic class knowledges through the method of [Impart Skills], and the knowledges of the other two classes were sold through the [Faction Store]. This meant that as long as the players joined the Black Star Corps, they could immediately learn these two free class advancement knowledges!

This instantly became a new benefit exclusive to the faction, just like how one could exchange for class knowledges after joining Godora and accumulating enough Merit. However, Han Xiao directly removed those restrictions, and they could directly use experience to 'learn' the knowledges.

Countless players were overjoyed and felt that they had made a killing!

The pro players who entered the galaxy in Version 1.0 shared the price of class knowledges in the galaxy. If one did not join a faction and only used money to purchase class knowledges, the class advancement knowledges would cost tens of thousands of Enas.

In comparison, the Black Star Corps' treatment was the best of the best!

In the eyes of the players, this was all thanks to them. It was because they had expanded the size of the faction and changed the name to [Black Star Corps] that the faction store updated with this new benefit. As expected of a growing faction!

Not taking money, only EXP — this was something that Han Xiao had done on purpose. His target customers were the players of the other two classes, so he could quickly accumulate EXP to reach level 140.

Han Technician's account now had more than 10,000,000 Enas. Burning more than 100,000 Enas for this was nothing in his eyes. He did not even bother to charge a symbolic fee. Even if he only charged one Enas, the effect was far better than free.

Class advancement knowledges were a necessity, and the number of buyers basically covered all the Blue Star players outside of the Mechanic class!

Spending more than 100,000 Enas, if he did not harvest a huge amount of experience, he would be letting his conscience down!

There was only one such cheap class advancement knowledges. The players did not hesitate and eagerly bought them. The effect of this move was obvious. The experience on Han Xiao's interface skyrocketed at a crazy speed.

300,000,000 … 600,000,000 … 1,000,000,000 …

The effect of 'free' was terrifying!

Looking at the speed of his experience increase, Han Xiaoxin was overjoyed.

The experience earned this time will probably not only allow me to reach level 140, but it can also be used for a period of time.

…

In just one day, the experience accumulated on the interface was enough to reach level 140.

In order to reach Grade A first, Han Xiao did not even have time to repair the Mech Legion. This attack made him understand that when the leeks were ripe, they had to be cut off as soon as possible. If he was already a Calamity Grade when he was surrounded by Ashes and the others, it would not have been so thrilling.

Han Xiao came to the training room in Base No.2, locked the door, and opened the interface.

Taking a deep breath, he invested experience into leveling up.

I can finally reach the Calamity Grade and officially step into the high-level combat power level!

Han Xiao was secretly excited.

…
